new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. The Clearfield City Council voted 4-0 on September 8, 2026 to adopt a 180-day moratorium prohibiting data center development in the city (through approximately March 7, 2027) while officials study whether special zoning guidelines are warranted. No data center proposal was found to be barred outright by the action; a pending zoning-determination request at the Freeport Center (Building J8) prompted the pause. No extension or replacement was found in sources reviewed through 2026-09-23.
new_candidates.affected_projects: A pending zoning-determination request (not yet a formal application) for a proposed data center in Building J8 at the Freeport Center, M-1 Manufacturing Zone; city staff's preliminary review found the use did not clearly fit existing warehouse or manufacturing classifications.
new_candidates.outcome: Clearfield City Council adopted a 180-day moratorium on data center development after a zoning-determination request exposed a gap in the city's zoning code.
